content.name: Linux runtime (Ubuntu 26.04 LTS)
content.note: Ubuntu 26.04 LTS arm64 runtime for DroidDeck, built by tools/ubuntu in Droid-Deck/DroidDeck (PR #1733); rc2 adds libxcb-keysyms1 so the DD-Turnip driver loads (PR #1773); rc3 adds libva-drm2 and libva-x11-2 so Proton's media decoder loads and game cutscenes play (PR #1823); rc4 adds liblzo2-2 so FEX's unsquashfs runs and the x86-64 Steam client starts (PR #1825). Its Kubuntu Plasma desktop pack is ubuntu-r1-rc4-desktop.tar.zst in the same release, named inside the runtime at usr/share/droiddeck/desktop-pack.json. Release candidate: only test builds of PR #1733 read this file.

content.name: FEX for the x86-64 Steam client
content.note: FEX built for the Linux runtime from tools/fex of Droid-Deck/DroidDeck c5577478caab6af7efc9fa806a706ef49ad6ca2a by build-fex.yml (host thunks, libraries the runtime lacks bundled). The app reads this file and installs the build only once its archive matches this sha256 and its programs load; the archive on the fex release is replaced with each build.
